invariants.rationale: inputRecords is dereferenced and used in method calls, so must not be null.
config is used for method calls (e.g. config.shouldCombineBeforeInsert()), must not be null.
partitioner is used for method calls (e.g. partitioner.repartitionRecords()), must not be null.
table is passed into methods and dereferenced, must not be null.
configuredParallelism is used for deducing targetParallelism and controlling parallelism, which is typically positive for partitioning/workload splitting.
